_meta.description: Product-intent confirmation record for every link the owner submitted, with the candidate Special Link for each. Intended ASIN, official listing URL, confirmation date and source are one group of fields; observed redirect targets are a separate group. The two are never merged: an observed target is evidence about where a link goes, not a statement of what the owner intends.
_meta.tracking_id_source: Supplied by the site owner in the 2026-11-17 brief as the 'Selected Tracking ID'. Not checked against Associates Central (no account access from this workspace; F-57).
_meta.tag_format_note: Official Associates help gives the direct product link as http://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN/ref=nosim?tag=YOURASSOCIATEID; the candidate uses that format with https and the supplied tracking ID.
_meta.asin_definition_note: Amazon's seller blog: an ASIN is a unique 10-character alphanumeric code. The submitted short codes are 9 characters, so they cannot be read as ASINs.
_meta.method: Each submitted link was opened with the page-fetch tool and the final URL and listing title recorded. Each candidate Special Link was opened the same way. The tool drops query strings from the URL it reports, so the tag itself cannot be seen in the result and tag attribution is recorded as unchecked.
_meta.validation_rule: Per Associates' one-link test (D-42): one candidate per product must be confirmed in the enrolled Associates workflow (destination and tracking report) before any live button changes. No live button has been changed.

status_legend.candidate: Built from the official format; not yet validated in Associates Central.
status_legend.validated: Destination and tracking report both confirmed in Associates Central by the owner (no row is validated yet).
